A hall in Aradippou

RACK GYM is on Ivikou 52 in Aradippou: a high hall with a mezzanine, green turf lanes, rubber flooring and racks of dumbbells. On Instagram the gym calls its motto building better humans, and members write about modern equipment, motivating coaches and a positive atmosphere. There is free parking, showers and free WiFi.
